Thanks Tim, I pulled it up. Order Shop····, placed August 1, paid, $893.97, Harlo B30 plus Power Kit to (address hidden). Nothing has shipped yet. It ships November 7.

The B30 batch is being built at the factory right now, and your order is in that batch. You can follow that shipment on its way to us here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

I hear you, and I'm sorry it moved. The September notice put batch 1 in mid October and the next batches in the first week of November. Your order sits in that November group, so the date on it now is November 7, with the free Power Kit we added for the wait and your price locked.

Batch 1 is still being built at the factory, and you can watch it move at https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Is November 7 workable for you, or do you want to talk options?
I was suppose to have it now

You're right, it should have been with you by now, and I'm sorry. The cooling redesign pushed the whole B30 run back and your order landed in the November group.

So you have three ways to go: keep the order and it ships November 7 at your locked price with the free Power Kit, swap it to something else in the catalog, or cancel it. I'd keep it, the B30 is the best value we sell and you're near the front of the queue now.

Which way do you want to go?
You lied about the shipping

That's fair. We gave you September 30, then mid October, and neither held. The dates slipped on us and you were the one left waiting on them, so I'm not going to argue it.

What I can give you is what's true today: the B30 run is in build and your order ships November 7. If that's not good enough after two misses, say the word and I'll move it to another product or put a person from the team on this with you.

What do you want to do?
I emailed 3 times and never got a respond! Is this a scam
Handed to the team · Three unanswered emails plus a trust problem after two missed dates; already com

We're not a scam, Tim. We're a real shop in Westmount, Quebec, your order is paid and sitting with the warehouse, and the B30 units are in build. Three emails with no reply is bad and I'm sorry, that shouldn't have happened.

I've pinged the team about this right now, so stay in the chat and Abel or Georges will jump in here. If you step away, the answer comes to this email.

Nothing on your order changes while that happens.
How can a company not respond to a customers questions and concerns

It shouldn't happen, and I'm not going to defend it. The team changed over recently and mail got dropped in the middle of it. That's our failure, not yours for asking.

You're not waiting on email now. The team has this chat flagged and one of them is coming into it. Meanwhile I'm here and I can do most things myself, including changing your order if that's what you want.

Is it the date you want sorted, or do you want out of this order?
Waiting for a human
